title: Figma marketing website, c. 2022
lede: Figma’s early-2020s marketing pages, named with Gumroad as a source of the style.
summary: Figma’s landing pages as described by Malewicz in March 2022.

evidence.note: Wayback Machine capture of figma.com from 28 February 2022, captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) and inspected on 25 September 2026.

styles.note: Malewicz (2022) names Figma and Gumroad as the “two main innovators” of neubrutalism, and NN/g repeats Figma as an example.

context: [Michał Malewicz, “Neubrutalism is taking over the web” (Hype4 Academy, first published 28 March 2022)](https://hype4.academy/articles/design/neubrutalism-is-taking-over-web) analyzes Figma landing-page sections: cards “purposefully inconsistent”, shapes like “template shapes from PowerPoint”, hard figure-to-background contrast, and thick, slightly quirky fonts.

[NN/g, “Neobrutalism: Definition and Best Practices” (Hayat Sheikh, 11 April 2025)](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/neobrutalism/) names “Figma's brand refresh” as an example, linking to [Figma’s October 2019 brand post](https://www.figma.com/blog/bringing-new-life-to-figmas-brand/) by Tori Hinn. That post predates the name and does not use it.
interpretation: The capture does not show the outline-and-hard-shadow grammar. It fails the fingerprint on outline width, radius, and shadows. Figma’s influence on the style, as Malewicz describes it, is in its playful stickers, bright accents, and hand-made marks, not in its layout components. The placement stays, but as an influence.
next: Check other Figma pages from 2021–2022, such as the Config and community pages, for stronger examples.

rights.statement: Figma’s design and content belong to Figma. Captured from the Internet Archive for commentary.

observed: White page with a centered black headline, “Nothing great is designed alone.”, in a large sans-serif. The word “designed” is violet inside a thin selection box with a cursor label.
Buttons are black with white text and rounded corners. No component has a thick outline or a hard shadow.
Below the hero, a mock Figma editor shows the product interface with small colorful stickers and a hand-drawn yellow stroke.

images.alt: Archived Figma home page: a white page with the headline “Nothing great is designed alone.” where “designed” is violet in a selection box, a black Try Figma for free button, and a mock editor interface with colorful stickers below.
images.caption: First viewport of the [February 2022 archived copy of figma.com](https://web.archive.org/web/20220228235551/https://www.figma.com/).
